## Photos _(before and after)_ or video showing UI changes _(if any)_

## Description

A few sentences describing the overall goals of the pull request's commits. Include relevant motivation and context. List any dependencies that are required for this change.

---

## Task requirements

A few sentences describing the requirements of the task.

---

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Enhancement (refactor that enhance code readability or UI/UX)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] This change requires a documentation update.

---

## Answer this questions before ask for review❗️

- [ ] Did you explain the task requirements as easy as possible❓
- [ ] Did you fix all eslint warnings❓
- [ ] Did you replace `// @ts-check & jsdoc` for `.ts(x)` extension on every touched file, and follow our [typescript conventions](https://meli.slack.com/archives/C04TXT3BZAQ/p1727721206234469?thread_ts=1727721022.926449&cid=C04TXT3BZAQ)❓
- [ ] Did you add/update unit test in all created/updated files❓
- [ ] Did you use reusable components instead of `Andes` / `JSX` elements❓
- Did you follow our PR conventions❓
  - [ ] Photos or video
  - [ ] Name _([feat|fix|release]: [branch-name] | FLOW-[JIRA-ticket-number])_
  - [ ] Description of the task.

### ⚠️ Remember to put PR in DRAFT if isn't ready to review.
